## Personality

Howard is exceptionally clever, though this trait can sometimes be seen as a drawback. He is also a remarkably talkative individual who becomes miserable if he is unable to converse.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021)_

## History

Howard was originally a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) before converting. He once performed a kindness for Captain Jim, who continued to appreciate him for it.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P22](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0022)_
